name: Streamline Systems
long_description:
Streamline Systems is building the replacement for GPS. 

Satellite positioning has become the single point of failure for almost every modern system, both military and civil. We've built the replacement. A drop-in module that integrates with existing Ardupilot, INAV and PX4 flight controllers, with demonstrated satellite-independent autonomous flight and GPS handoff. We're currently working with commercial and military end users to deploy the capability.
one_liner: Precision navigation for UAVs operating without GPS.
